name: Honeytra
source:
A spy from the Central Empire. Specializing in "Honey Traps", using sex photos of herself to blackmail Japanese commanders. [spoiler] Was sent to Japan to kidnap Mikado, but was easily caught because she was too famous. She has a lot of Japanese men that are her fans due to flat chest. Unused to be a commander so she's struggling.[/spoiler] Her age is a great mystery.

"Noooo!!! All Japanese people are lolicooooons!!!"
